biography:
As the Global Sales Director at Digital Realty, I lead a team of sales professionals who deliver client-driven data center and colocation solutions to various industry verticals. With over 20 years of sales experience in the technology industry, I have a deep understanding of the telecommunications, cloud market, and technology trends that shape the data center needs of our customers and partners. 

My core competencies include strategic global sales and business development, customer and partner relationships, complex sales process and contract negotiations, and team-building and leadership. I have consistently exceeded revenue goals and secured global accounts with Fortune 1000 companies and service providers. I am passionate about enabling and empowering our clients to achieve their business objectives with secure, reliable, and cost-effective data center solutions.
